purpose: Canonical public-facing visibility and readiness state for THC foundational certificates and professional credential pathways. This file controls catalog messaging only; it does not authorize credential issuance.

statusDefinitions.available-academic: Public learning content is available, but this does not mean a professional credential is currently issuable.
statusDefinitions.in-development: The pathway has active curriculum/program development but is not approved for credential issuance.
statusDefinitions.planned: The pathway is defined in the canonical architecture but does not yet have a complete production course/program package.
statusDefinitions.release-ready: All required release evidence has been approved and the credential may be offered. No current offering should use this state unless the corresponding release-evidence record is complete.
